dom.title: Passport — scoped, revocable grants for delegated agent actions · Origin
dom.text:
Skip to main content

Passport is a local demo of scoped, revocable grants for delegated agent actions — static fixtures, no real accounts, tools, or money.

Passport
Origin Labs · delegated access
🔒
Read-only preview — sign in as the Origin owner to run Passport live.
Sign in →
Local demo · static fixtures, no real accounts, tools, or money · scoped, revocable permissions
Capability is not permission.

In this local demo of delegated autonomy, the agent proposes a plan, Passport issues a scoped, revocable grant, and every real-world action waits for your approval.

We’re building Passport because the next platform shift isn’t smarter agents — it’s agents you can trust to act. Identity-bound, policy-governed, user-authorized, auditable, revocable.

SPEAK WHAT YOU WANT — YOUR AGENT DOES THE REST
🎙

WHY PASSPORT ADVANCES THE INFRASTRUCTURE FOR SAFE AGENT ADOPTION
AI security
Agents operate inside bounded, testable, fail-closed systems.
Agent security
Every action is tied to identity, scope, policy, and revocation.
Governance
Intent, permissions, approvals, denials, and residual risk are explicit and auditable.
Trust
You can understand, approve, inspect, and revoke what agents do on your behalf.
Safe deployment
Powerful workflows without silent overreach, credential exposure, or runaway spend.
MORE FLOWS PASSPORT GOVERNS
Recover My Evening
CARD

“My meeting ran late. Re-plan my evening without losing the important parts.”

🛡 The agent can propose reschedules but cannot cancel, message, or rebook without approval.
See it in “Airport Pickup” →
Trusted Hackmate Coordination
IN A LIVE SCENARIO

“Find which of my hackmates are near SF tonight, share the event plan, and coordinate who can bring what.”

🛡 Contacts are private and read by group only. Messages are drafted, never sent without approval.
See it in “Fill My Night” →
Credentialed Task Without Exposure
IN A LIVE SCENARIO

“Use my event account to prepare registration, but do not reveal or store my password.”

🛡 The agent never sees the raw secret — Passport brokers a scoped, opaque handle.
See it in “Fill My Night” →
Revoke Agent Access
IN A LIVE SCENARIO

“Stop this agent from doing anything else after this task.”

🛡 Revocation is obvious, immediate, and verifiable — every later action fails closed.
Passport · local demo
Capability is not permission. The agent can propose; Passport decides what it may do.
No real actions · credentials stay brokered, scoped, revocable
